==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Dream One:
My friend is transforming into a monster. His thoughts have become a lot darker. I can see his aura, which resembles a thick black fog.

I follow my friend down a city street. I am afraid of what he might do if I leave him by himself. I lose track of him, as he starts to physically change into a ghost.

I see a woman on the street. I want to protect her from my friend. I walk her into a random office building to hide in, where we stay until I eventually wake up.

Dream Two:
I am on a constellation of stars on a black two-dimensional plane. I can feel the minds of the world. In the center of the plane is a giant constellation of green stars resembling the head of a Sentai Ranger.

I ask the star ranger about how we can know anything. The star ranger says that we are all connected to the plane. Everything is connected.
